what: does raising rule-training (cyc_rule 25->100) or weakening irregular entrenchment (cyc_irr 48->12) rescue reg_acc in the SINGLE shared pool?
finding: ARCHITECTURAL trade-off confirmed: strengthening the rule route raises reg_acc (to 0.5-1.0) but COLLAPSES irregular blocking (irr_acc 0.86->0.0-0.57). No single operating point in the shared pool satisfies BOTH reg_acc>=0.90 AND blocking. Confirms the NO-GO is architectural (separate systems needed), not operating-point.
